language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Follows the system by default; remembered after you switch.

shortcut.title: Global Shortcut
shortcut.desc: Press this key combination from any screen to toggle the Spotlight search window. Takes effect immediately; no restart needed.
shortcut.hint: Click the control above, then press the target key combination (must include a modifier: Ctrl / Alt / Shift). Press Esc to cancel.

workspacePath.title: Workspace Path
workspacePath.desc: Root directory for Claude / Codex sessions (saved locally only in MVP; not synced to backend).
workspacePath.hint: Leave empty to use the default path (~/.claude / ~/.codex).

projectDefaultTab.title: Project Default Tab
projectDefaultTab.desc: The tab shown when opening a project. The system remembers the last-visited tab per project and prefers that; this setting is the fallback for projects never opened before.

autoArchive.title: Auto-archive Completed Tasks
autoArchive.desc: When opening a project, tasks that have been in the "Done" column longer than the selected threshold are auto-archived (soft-delete; sessions/commit provenance is kept, hidden from board by default; you can view or un-archive them at any time). No data is deleted.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.desc: Configure the model service for the project workspace's AI tab; keys are stored locally only.

model.label: Model
model.fetchEmpty: No models returned; please enter manually
model.fetchError: Failed to fetch models; please enter manually: {{message}}

ai.cliHint: Invokes the local {{cmd}} CLI (uses your local subscription; data never leaves this machine). If you see "program not found" but it works in your terminal, paste the absolute path above (run where {{cmd}} in the terminal to find it).

embed.title: Retrieval / Embeddings
embed.desc: Configure the embedding service for semantic search in Ask mode; keys are stored locally only.
embed.mockWarning: Mock uses placeholder vectors — not real semantics. Ask mode will fall back to <1>keyword search</1>; choose local or api for semantic search.
embed.localWarning: Local embeddings require a build with <1>--features local-embed</1>; if not included in the current build, selecting it silently falls back to keywords. For out-of-the-box semantics, use api (you can reuse the AI key in one click).
embed.reuseAiKey: Reuse OpenAI key from AI config for semantic search
embed.reuseAiKeyTitle: Copy the OpenAI base_url/key from AI config into embeddings (api)
embed.reuseAiKeyDisabledTitle: Set the AI assistant provider to OpenAI and enter an API key first
embed.reuseAiKeySuccess: OpenAI key reused from AI config (click 'Rebuild index' to enable semantics)
embed.indexStale: Embedding config changed (last indexed with {{model}}); semantic search may be stale — click 'Rebuild index'.
embed.rebuildEmpty: No sessions to index yet (scan may still be in progress)

dataNote.api: When using the cloud API, session chunks are sent to the configured Embedding endpoint; review your privacy settings.
dataNote.local: Current mode (local / mock) keeps all data on device; nothing is sent externally.

mcp.title: MCP Integration (claude / codex)
mcp.desc: Let local claude / codex directly operate your board tasks and docs. Writes to the client config in one click — no manual commands needed. Restart the client session for changes to take effect.
mcp.endpointNotReady: MCP endpoint not ready (app may have just started — re-open settings in a moment).
mcp.hint: Note: the secret is persisted, the port is fixed at 47600, and the connection stays valid long-term (unless the port is taken). Local only (127.0.0.1); Keelson must be running.

claudeIntegration.title: Claude Code Integration
claudeIntegration.desc: Enable Keelson–Claude Code integration in one click: ① every tool call streams to the <1>activity feed</1> (board sync depends on it); ② long-running processes started by Claude (e.g. <2>npm run dev</2>) are <3>auto-managed</3> in the Processes page. Only Keelson's two hooks are added or removed; all other settings are preserved. Restart your Claude session for changes to take effect.
claudeIntegration.enableSuccess: Claude Code integration enabled: tool stream reporting + auto-managed processes (restart session to take effect)
claudeIntegration.upgradeSuccess: Upgraded to latest (restart your Claude session to take effect)
claudeIntegration.hint: Note: Codex has no per-tool hooks — it reports board/doc actions via MCP only (above); full real-time tool streaming and process interception are Claude Code-only features.

autoSyncTasks.title: Auto-sync Board (CLI Tasks)
autoSyncTasks.desc: When enabled, tasks created or updated in Claude sessions (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate) are synced to their linked project board in real time. When disabled, you can still sync manually from the session preview. Requires the activity hook (above) to be enabled.

notify.title: Notification Preferences
notify.desc: Control which notification types are written to the bell / inbox and whether desktop system notifications are shown. When disabled, that type is neither created nor displayed (including notifications of that type written by external agents).
notify.newSessionsLabel: Notify when new local CLI sessions are discovered (one summary at startup; requires the Session type to be enabled)

backend.title: Backend / Remote PocketBase
backend.desc: By default, the built-in local PocketBase is used (no login required). Enter a remote URL to connect to a remote instance with email/password login,
backend.note: Note (minimal): Session metadata sync still writes to local PB; Board / Docs / Reading / Calendar / Notifications and other data use the selected backend.

updater.title: Software Updates
updater.upToDate: You're up to date (or update source not configured).

export.title: Data Export
export.desc: JSON is a full backup; Markdown is human-readable / archivable.
